# hudu_company (Resource)

Manages a Hudu company.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hudu_company" "acme" {
  name           = "Acme Corp"
  nickname       = "Acme"
  company_type   = "Customer"
  address_line_1 = "123 Main St"
  city           = "Denver"
  state          = "CO"
  zip            = "80202"
  country_name   = "USA"
  phone_number   = "+1-555-0100"
  website        = "https://acme.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Company name.

### Optional

- `address_line_1` (String) First line of the company's address.
- `address_line_2` (String) Second line of the company's address.
- `city` (String) City of the company's address.
- `company_type` (String) Free-form company type label.
- `country_name` (String) Country of the company's address.
- `fax_number` (String) Fax number.
- `id_number` (String) Custom identifier (id_number in the API).
- `nickname` (String) Short nickname for the company.
- `notes` (String) Additional notes about the company.
- `parent_company_id` (Number) ID of the parent company, for child companies.
- `phone_number` (String) Primary phone number.
- `state` (String) State or province of the company's address.
- `website` (String) Company website URL.
- `zip` (String) Postal code of the company's address.

### Read-Only

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the company is archived. Archived companies are hidden from the regular Hudu lists but remain retrievable.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp the company was created, in ISO 8601 UTC (e.g. `2026-01-15T12:34:56.789Z`).
- `full_url` (String) Absolute URL of the company in the Hudu web UI.
- `id` (String) Numeric ID assigned by Hudu, as a string.
- `slug` (String) URL slug generated by Hudu.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp the company was last updated, in ISO 8601 UTC.
- `url` (String) Path to the company in the Hudu web UI, relative to the instance host (e.g. `/c/31fd7a1755c3`).
